questions.question: How do scientists calculate overall global surface temperatures?
options: By taking a single temperature reading at the equator each day
From tens of thousands of measurements worldwide
By averaging temperatures from only three capital cities
By estimating temperatures from satellite cloud images alone

questions.question: How do scientists analyze regional temperature changes to see if they are unusual?
options: They compare them with the long-term average for each region
They compare them to the temperature of the nearest ocean only
They check if the temperature is always exactly 20 degrees Celsius
They compare them only with the temperature at the South Pole

questions.question: Where do scientists obtain physical data about longer-term temperature changes from hundreds of years ago?
options: From old weather reports broadcast on the radio
From tree rings and ice cores
By measuring the depth of the ocean floor
From the magnetic alignment of modern volcanic rocks

questions.question: Which of the following statements comparing carbon dioxide and methane is correct?
options: Carbon dioxide is a more potent greenhouse gas than methane
Methane is a more potent greenhouse gas than carbon dioxide
Methane and carbon dioxide have the exact same warming effect
Methane has no warming effect on the atmosphere

questions.question: What is the main effect of greenhouse gases on Earth's atmosphere?
options: They keep the atmosphere warmer than it would be without them
They block all incoming heat from the Sun
They cool down the planet by reflecting all sunlight
They prevent oxygen from escaping into outer space

questions.question: Why does the melting of sea ice in summer not raise sea levels?
options: Because it does not add water to the sea
Because ocean water contracts as it gets colder
Because wind blows the melted ice onto the land
Because sea ice melts directly into underground caves

questions.question: Other than the melting of ice sheets, what causes sea levels to rise as temperatures increase?
options: Warmer oceans and seas expand
Undersea volcanic activity increases
The speed of ocean currents increases
Evaporation from the oceans stops completely

questions.question: Which statement describes the difference in fuel usage between electric and petrol or diesel vehicles?
options: Electric vehicles burn fuel in their engines, while petrol vehicles do not
Petrol and diesel vehicles burn fuels, while electric vehicles do not, though fuels may be burned to generate electricity
Petrol vehicles produce zero emissions, whereas electric vehicles produce high amounts of exhaust gases
Electric vehicles must burn hydrogen, while diesel vehicles run entirely on battery power

questions.question: What happens during the process of carbon capture and storage?
options: It converts carbon dioxide into oxygen using mechanical trees
It separates CO2 from other emissions and stores it in suitable deep underground locations
It compresses carbon dioxide into solid blocks to build houses
It dissolves carbon dioxide into the surface of oceans to feed fish

questions.question: What is a major disadvantage of carbon capture and storage technology?
options: It is very expensive
It increases the amount of CO2 emitted
It can only be used in space
It has been proven to make global warming worse

questions.question: Approximately what percentage of global greenhouse gas emissions is produced by the energy sector?
Under what conditions will a car use more energy to travel a distance of 100 km?
options: If it is lighter and travels at lower speeds
If it is heavier or travels at higher speeds
If it is painted a dark colour and has fewer passengers
If its windows are closed and it travels downhill

questions.question: How can a driver reduce the amount of energy a car uses during travel?
options: By keeping the tyres inflated to the correct air pressure
By driving with under-inflated tyres
By removing the car's air filter
By using the highest possible gear at very low speeds

questions.question: Why will renewable energy resources not run out?
options: Because they are replenished more quickly than we use them up
Because they are made of synthetic man-made materials
Because they are kept inside sealed containers
Because they only operate during daytime hours

questions.question: How can a turbine be spun to generate electricity without burning fuel?
options: By using falling water or wind
By burning coal or oil
By using solar light beams
By using heat from electric radiators

questions.question: Which of the following is able to produce electricity without using an electric generator?
options: Wind turbines
Coal-fired power stations
Solar panels
Hydroelectric dams

questions.question: What is a predicted benefit of reducing global greenhouse gas emissions?
options: It can reduce the rate of global warming and may even help to reverse it
It will immediately stop the Earth from spinning on its axis
It will cause the Earth's atmosphere to freeze completely
It will prevent any heat from the Sun from reaching Earth
